faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Anganwadi Worker posts is 03 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Anganwadi Worker position is a +2 pass (12th grade) from a recognized board or institution. Candidates must meet this requirement to be eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to the Anganwadi Worker position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Anganwadi Worker post is between 18 years and 35 years. Specific age relaxations are provided for certain categories as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker vacancies?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official WCD Odisha website. The application process involves filling out the online form, uploading necessary documents, and submitting it before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Anganwadi Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the Anganwadi Worker recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Anganwadi Worker posts includes online application submission, followed by document verification. A merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained and additional points.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Anganwadi Worker position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Anganwadi Worker position is on a contract basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as specified by the department.
